```bash
.venv/bin/python - << 'PY'
import torch
from unified_hoi.token_ar.codecs import load_codecs, canonicalize
from unified_hoi.token_ar.data import MotionDataset
from unified_hoi.token_ar.body import digest_file, split_human
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader

device=torch.device("cuda:0")
codecs, saved = load_codecs("runs/token_ar/behave/vq_residual_ema_512x4096/last.pt", device=device)
support=digest_file("data/parametric_assets/behave/contact_support.npz")
ds=MotionDataset("data/processed/behave_parametric.jsonl","val","behave",support,120,include_geometry=False)
print("windows", len(ds), "step", saved.get("step"))
h=codecs.models["human"]; o=codecs.models["object"]
print("human std mean/min/max", float(h.std.mean()), float(h.std.min()), float(h.std.max()))
print("object std", o.std.detach().cpu().tolist())
print("object mean", o.mean.detach().cpu().tolist())

# parameter errors over all windows, native frames
hs, os_t, os_r = [], [], []
nframes=0
for i in range(len(ds)):
    batch=next(iter(DataLoader(ds, batch_sampler=[[i]])))
    batch={k:(v.to(device) if torch.is_tensor(v) else v) for k,v in batch.items()}
    n=int(batch["valid_frames"].sum())
    enc=codecs.encode(batch)
    dec={k: codecs.models[k].decode(enc[k][0], n) for k in ("human","object","contact")}
    dh, do = canonicalize(dec["human"], dec["object"], "behave")
    gt_h, gt_o = batch["human"][0,:n], batch["object"][0,:n]
    # translation
    hs.append((dh[:,-3:]-gt_h[:,-3:]).norm(dim=-1).mean())
    os_t.append((do[:,:3]-gt_o[:,:3]).norm(dim=-1).mean())
    # rotation 6d
    os_r.append((do[:,3:]-gt_o[:,3:]).norm(dim=-1).mean())
    nframes += n
print("frames", nframes)
print("human transl L2 m", float(torch.stack(hs).mean()))
print("object transl L2 m", float(torch.stack(os_t).mean()))
print("object rot6d L2", float(torch.stack(os_r).mean()))
# normalized recon mse like training
def nrmse(model, pred, gt):
    return float((((pred-gt)/model.std)**2).mean().sqrt())
# recompute on last batch only is not enough; accumulate
acc_h=acc_o=cnt=0
for i in range(0,len(ds),8):
    pass
print("done sample means above are unweighted window means")
PY
```

```bash
def take(ds, n):
    idx=np.linspace(0, len(ds)-1, n, dtype=int)
    return [int(i) for i in idx]

def recon(module, values):
    n=values.shape[0]
    z=module._latent(values)
    ids=module._nearest(z)
    q=module.codebook(ids)
    pred_z=module._decode(z, n)
    pred_q=module._decode(q, n)
    if module.contact:
        pred_z, pred_q = pred_z.sigmoid(), pred_q.sigmoid()
    qerr=(z-q).square().mean().item()
    # relative quant error
    rel=(z-q).norm(dim=-1).mean().item() / (z.norm(dim=-1).mean().item()+1e-8)
    return pred_z, pred_q, qerr, rel, ids

def mpjpe(pred, gt, gender):
    # pred/gt [T,D]
    _, pj = geom(pred[None], gender)
    _, gj = geom(gt[None], gender)
    pj, gj = pj[0], gj[0]
    a, b = pj-pj[:, :1], gj-gj[:, :1]
    pel=float((pj[:,0]-gj[:,0]).norm(dim=-1).mean())
    mp=float((a-b).norm(dim=-1).mean())
    # procrustes per frame, subsample if needed
    pa=[]
    A=a.detach().cpu().numpy(); B=b.detach().cpu().numpy()
    for x,y in zip(A,B):
        x=x-x.mean(0); y=y-y.mean(0)
        u,_,vh=np.linalg.svd(x.T@y)
        r=u@vh
        if np.linalg.det(r)<0:
            u[:,-1]*=-1
            r=u@vh
        pa.append(np.linalg.norm(x@r-y, axis=-1).mean())
    return mp, float(np.mean(pa)), pel

    beta, pose, trans = split_human(gt, 'behave')

    if 'trans' in parts: trans=parts['trans']
    if 'root' in parts: pose=pose.clone(); pose[:,0]=parts['root']
    if 'body' in parts: pose=pose.clone(); pose[:,1:22]=parts['body']
    if 'hands' in parts: pose=pose.clone(); pose[:,22:]=parts['hands']
    if 'pose' in parts: pose=parts['pose']
    return torch.cat((beta, pose.flatten(1), trans), -1)
```

```bash
.venv/bin/python - << 'PY'
import torch, numpy as np
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader
from unified_hoi.token_ar.codecs import load_codecs, canonicalize
from unified_hoi.token_ar.data import MotionDataset
from unified_hoi.token_ar.body import digest_file, BodyGeometry, split_human
from unified_hoi.geometry import rotation6d_to_matrix

device=torch.device('cuda:0')
codecs,_=load_codecs('runs/token_ar/behave/vq_residual_ema_512x4096/last.pt', device=device)
support='data/parametric_assets/behave/contact_support.npz'
sh=digest_file(support)
geom=BodyGeometry('behave', support).to(device).eval()
hmod,omod=codecs.models['human'], codecs.models['object']
std=hmod.std

def ds(split, stride):
    return MotionDataset('data/processed/behave_parametric.jsonl', split, 'behave', sh, 120, stride=stride, include_geometry=False)

def recon(module, values):
    n=values.shape[0]
    z=module._latent(values)
    ids=module._nearest(z)
    q=module.codebook(ids)
    pz, pq = module._decode(z, n), module._decode(q, n)
    if module.contact:
        pz, pq = pz.sigmoid(), pq.sigmoid()
    rel=float((z-q).norm(-1).mean() / (z.norm(-1).mean()+1e-8))
    return pz, pq, rel

def ang(a, b):
    Ra, Rb = rotation6d_to_matrix(a.reshape(-1,6)), rotation6d_to_matrix(b.reshape(-1,6))
    c=((Ra.transpose(-1,-2)@Rb).diagonal(dim1=-2,dim2=-1).sum(-1)-1)/2
    return float(torch.rad2deg(torch.acos(c.clamp(-1,1))).mean())

def mpjpe(pred, gt, gender):
    _, pj = geom(pred[None], gender)
    _, gj = geom(gt[None], gender)
    a, b = (pj-pj[:,:1])[0].detach().cpu().numpy(), (gj-gj[:,:1])[0].detach().cpu().numpy()
    mp=float(np.linalg.norm(a-b, axis=-1).mean())
    pa=[]
    for x,y in zip(a,b):
        x=x-x.mean(0); y=y-y.mean(0)
        u,_,vh=np.linalg.svd(x.T@y)
        r=u@vh
        if np.linalg.det(r)<0:
            u[:,-1]*=-1; r=u@vh
        pa.append(np.linalg.norm(x@r-y, axis=-1).mean())
    pel=float((pj[0,:,0]-gj[0,:,0]).norm(-1).mean())
    return mp, float(np.mean(pa)), pel

def splice(gt, beta=None, pose=None, trans=None, root=None, body=None, hands=None):
    b,p,t=split_human(gt,'behave')
    b,p,t=b.clone(), p.clone(), t.clone()
    if beta is not None: b=beta
    if pose is not None: p=pose
    if trans is not None: t=trans
    if root is not None: p[:,0]=root
    if body is not None: p[:,1:22]=body
    if hands is not None: p[:,22:]=hands
    return torch.cat((b, p.flatten(1), t), -1)

def nmse(a,b,sl):
    return float((((a-b)/std[sl]).square().mean()))

for split, stride, n in (('val', 120, 24), ('train', 60, 24)):
    data=ds(split, stride)
    idx=np.linspace(0, len(data)-1, n, dtype=int)
    acc={}
    def add(k,v):
        acc.setdefault(k, []).append(v)
    for i in idx:
        batch=next(iter(DataLoader(data, batch_sampler=[[int(i)]])))
        batch={k:(v.to(device) if torch.is_tensor(v) else v) for k,v in batch.items()}
        T=int(batch['valid_frames'].sum()); gender=batch['gender']
        gt=batch['human'][0,:T]; go=batch['object'][0,:T]
        hz,hq,hrel=recon(hmod, gt)
        oz,oq,orel=recon(omod, go)
        hq,oq=canonicalize(hq, oq, 'behave')
        hz,oz=canonicalize(hz, oz, 'behave')
        gb,gp,gtr=split_human(gt,'behave')
        qb,qp,qtr=split_human(hq,'behave')
        add('quant_rel', hrel); add('obj_quant_rel', orel)
        add('nmse', nmse(hq,gt,slice(None)))
        add('nmse_beta', nmse(hq[:,:10],gt[:,:10],slice(0,10)))
        add('nmse_root', nmse(hq[:,10:16],gt[:,10:16],slice(10,16)))
        add('nmse_body', nmse(hq[:,16:142],gt[:,16:142],slice(16,142)))
        add('nmse_hand', nmse(hq[:,142:322],gt[:,142:322],slice(142,322)))
        add('nmse_trans', nmse(hq[:,-3:],gt[:,-3:],slice(-3,None)))
        add('trans_cm', float((qtr-gtr).norm(-1).mean())*100)
        add('root_deg', ang(qp[:,:1], gp[:,:1]))
        add('body_deg', ang(qp[:,1:22], gp[:,1:22]))
        add('hand_deg', ang(qp[:,22:], gp[:,22:]))
        mp,pa,pel=mpjpe(hq,gt,gender)
        mpz,paz,_=mpjpe(hz,gt,gender)
        add('mpjpe_q', mp*100); add('pa_q', pa*100); add('pelvis_cm', pel*100)
        add('mpjpe_cont', mpz*100); add('pa_cont', paz*100)
        variants={
            'only_trans': splice(gt, trans=qtr),
            'only_root': splice(gt, root=qp[:,0]),
            'only_body': splice(gt, body=qp[:,1:22]),
            'only_hands': splice(gt, hands=qp[:,22:]),
            'only_beta': splice(gt, beta=qb),
            'pose_keep_trans': splice(gt, pose=qp, beta=qb),
        }
        for name,seq in variants.items():
            m,_,_=mpjpe(seq, gt, gender)
            add(name, m*100)
        add('obj_t_cm', float((oq[:,:3]-go[:,:3]).norm(-1).mean())*100)
        add('obj_t_cont_cm', float((oz[:,:3]-go[:,:3]).norm(-1).mean())*100)
        add('obj_deg', ang(oq[:,3:], go[:,3:]))
        add('obj_deg_cont', ang(oz[:,3:], go[:,3:]))
    print(f'\n== {split} n={n} / {len(data)} windows')
    for k,v in acc.items():
        print(f'{k:16} {np.mean(v):8.3f}')

for name,m in (('human',hmod),('object',omod)):
    w=m.codebook.weight.detach().float()
    sel=w[:64]
    d=torch.cdist(sel,sel)
    d=d[torch.triu(torch.ones_like(d),1).bool()]
    print(name, 'mean_code_norm', round(float(w.norm(-1).mean()),3), 'mean_pair', round(float(d.mean()),3), 'ema>1', int((m.ema_count>1).sum()), 'std', [round(float(x),3) for x in (m.std.min(), m.std.median(), m.std.max())])
```

训练集 PA-MPJPE 仅 3.4 cm，物体旋转误差 0.3°，验证集根旋转却高达 78°、物体旋转 16°。这说明 tokenizer 对训练窗口存在过拟合。

24 个训练窗口虽通过 linspace 分布在 1745 个窗口中，但 9 cm 与 57 cm 的差距证实了泛化能力不足。

连续潜空间重建（mpjpe_cont 50.9 cm）本身已严重失准，量化后仅增加约 6 cm。更异常的是：训练阶段连续重建反而比量化重建差（28 cm vs 9 cm），这与直觉矛盾。

训练集上连续潜空间重建（27.9 cm）反而比量化重建（9.4 cm）差，这与直觉矛盾。原因在于解码器可能仅针对码本向量训练，对原始编码器输出不敏感；commitment 未能将潜变量完全拉向码本，导致连续解码质量下降。

验证集量化相对误差高达 0.91，说明编码器输出与训练阶段学好的码本严重脱节。这可能源于训练集过拟合、训练与验证的动作/物体分布差异，或评估时归一化存在 bug。但训练与验证使用相同代码路径且训练效果正常，因此排除了评估专用 bug 的可能。

官方完整验证的 MPJPE 为 36.9 cm，而非此前 57 cm。这说明 24 窗口采样可能因 linspace 命中了更长或更难的片段，导致结果偏高。官方指标基于 1fps 子采样，可能过滤了高误差帧；但即使如此，也不太可能将 57 cm 降至 37 cm。因此官方数值应作为 headline 基准，当前分解仅作方向性参考。

```bash
import torch, numpy as np
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader
from unified_hoi.token_ar.codecs import load_codecs, canonicalize
from unified_hoi.token_ar.data import MotionDataset
from unified_hoi.token_ar.body import digest_file, split_human

device=torch.device('cuda:0')
codecs,saved=load_codecs('runs/token_ar/behave/vq_residual_ema_512x4096/last.pt', device=device)
h=codecs.models['human']
w=h.codebook.weight.detach()
print('weight', tuple(w.shape), 'absmean', float(w.abs().mean()), 'absmax', float(w.abs().max()), 'norm', float(w.norm(dim=1).mean()))
print('ema_count min/med/max', float(h.ema_count.min()), float(h.ema_count.median()), float(h.ema_count.max()))
ema=h.ema_sum/h.ema_count.clamp_min(1e-5)[:,None]
print('ema code norm', float(ema.norm(dim=1).mean()), 'weight vs ema max', float((w-ema).abs().max()))
print('std[-3:]', h.std[-3:].tolist(), 'mean[-3:]', h.mean[-3:].tolist())
print('std[:10]', h.std[:10].tolist())
# how many dims at clamp
print('frac std==0.05', float((h.std<=0.0501).float().mean()), 'of', h.std.numel())

sh=digest_file('data/parametric_assets/behave/contact_support.npz')
ds=MotionDataset('data/processed/behave_parametric.jsonl','val','behave',sh,120,include_geometry=False)
batch=next(iter(DataLoader(ds, batch_sampler=[[0]])))
batch={k:(v.to(device) if torch.is_tensor(v) else v) for k,v in batch.items()}
T=int(batch['valid_frames'].sum())
gt=batch['human'][0,:T]
z=h._latent(gt)
ids=h._nearest(z)
q=h.codebook(ids)
pred=h._decode(q, T)
pred,_=canonicalize(pred, batch['object'][0,:T], 'behave')
print('T', T, 'tokens', tuple(ids.shape), 'unique', int(torch.unique(ids).numel()))
print('z norm', float(z.norm(-1).mean()), 'q norm', float(q.norm(-1).mean()), 'rel', float((z-q).norm(-1).mean()/z.norm(-1).mean()))
print('raw trans err m', float((pred[:,-3:]-gt[:,-3:]).norm(-1).mean()))
print('pred trans mean', pred[:,-3:].mean(0).tolist())
print('gt trans mean', gt[:,-3:].mean(0).tolist())
b,p,t=split_human(pred,'behave')
print('split trans err', float((t-gt[:,-3:]).norm(-1).mean()))
print('root6 err', float((pred[:,10:16]-gt[:,10:16]).abs().mean()), 'body6', float((pred[:,16:142]-gt[:,16:142]).abs().mean()))
# compare encode() API
enc=h.encode(gt[None], batch['valid_frames'])[0]
print('encode ids equal', bool(torch.equal(enc, ids)))
dec=h.decode(enc, T)
dec,_=canonicalize(dec, batch['object'][0,:T], 'behave')
print('decode API trans err', float((dec[:,-3:]-gt[:,-3:]).norm(-1).mean()))
print('seq', ds.records[ds.windows[0][0]]['sequence_id'])
```

    mp=np.linalg.norm(a-b,axis=-1).mean()

        u,_,vh=np.linalg.svd(x.T@y); r=u@vh
        if np.linalg.det(r)&lt;0:
            u[:,-1]*=-1; r=u@vh
        pas.append(np.linalg.norm(x@r-y,axis=-1).mean())

            q=module.codebook(module._nearest(z))

        add(&#39;body&#39;, float(geo_deg(qp[:,1:22], gp[:,1:22]).mean()))
        add(&#39;body_z&#39;, float(geo_deg(zp[:,1:22], gp[:,1:22]).mean()))

        add(&#39;obj_t&#39;, float(torch.linalg.vector_norm(oq[:,:3]-go[:,:3],dim=-1).mean())*100)

            mb,_=mpjpe(pack(gt, pose=torch.cat((gp[:,:1], qp[:,1:22], gp[:,22:]),1)), gt, gender)

    print(f&#39;\n== {split} sampled {len(idx)}/{len(data)}&#39;)
    for k,v in acc.items():

run(&#39;val&#39;,120,fk=False)
run(&#39;train&#39;,60,n=24,fk=False)

```bash
        if np.linalg.det(r)<0:
            u[:,-1]*=-1; r=u@vh
        pas.append(np.linalg.norm(x@r-y,axis=-1).mean())
    return mp*100, float(np.mean(pas))*100

groups={'beta':slice(0,10),'root':slice(10,16),'body':slice(16,142),'hand':slice(142,322),'trans':slice(322,325)}
print('clamped frac by group:')
for k,sl in groups.items():
    s=std[sl]
    print(f'  {k:5} n={s.numel():3} std_med={float(s.median()):.3f} clamped={(float((s<=0.0501).float().mean())):.2f}')

def run(split, stride, n=None, fk=False):
    data=load(split, stride)
    idx=range(len(data)) if n is None else np.linspace(0,len(data)-1,n,dtype=int)
    acc={}
    def add(k,v):
        acc.setdefault(k,[]).append(v)
    for i in idx:
        batch=next(iter(DataLoader(data, batch_sampler=[[int(i)]])))
        gender=batch['gender'].to(device)
        T=int(batch['valid_frames'].sum())
        gt=batch['human'][0,:T].to(device)
        go=batch['object'][0,:T].to(device)
        def both(module, x):
            z=module._latent(x)
            q=module.codebook(module._nearest(z))
            dz,dq=module._decode(z,x.shape[0]), module._decode(q,x.shape[0])
            rel=float((z-q).norm(dim=-1).mean()/(z.norm(dim=-1).mean()+1e-8))

        gb,gp,gtr=split_human(gt,'behave')
        qb,qp,qtr=split_human(hq,'behave')
        zb,zp,ztr=split_human(hz,'behave')
        add('hrel',hrel); add('orel',orel)
        add('trans', float(torch.linalg.vector_norm(qtr-gtr,dim=-1).mean())*100)
        add('trans_z', float(torch.linalg.vector_norm(ztr-gtr,dim=-1).mean())*100)
        add('root', float(geo_deg(qp[:,:1], gp[:,:1]).mean()))
        add('root_z', float(geo_deg(zp[:,:1], gp[:,:1]).mean()))
        add('body', float(geo_deg(qp[:,1:22], gp[:,1:22]).mean()))
        add('body_z', float(geo_deg(zp[:,1:22], gp[:,1:22]).mean()))
        # loss mass = dim * nmse
        for name,sl in groups.items():
            add('L_'+name, float((((hq[:,sl]-gt[:,sl])/std[sl]).square().mean())* (sl.stop-sl.start)))
        add('obj_t', float(torch.linalg.vector_norm(oq[:,:3]-go[:,:3],dim=-1).mean())*100)
        add('obj_r', float(geo_deg(oq[:,3:], go[:,3:]).mean()))
        add('obj_r_z', float(geo_deg(oz[:,3:], go[:,3:]).mean()))
        if fk:
            mq,pq=mpjpe(hq,gt,gender)
            mz,pz=mpjpe(hz,gt,gender)
            add('mpjpe',mq); add('pa',pq); add('mpjpe_z',mz); add('pa_z',pz)
            mt,_=mpjpe(pack(gt, trans=qtr), gt, gender)
            mr,_=mpjpe(pack(gt, pose=torch.cat((qp[:,:1], gp[:,1:]),1)), gt, gender)
            mb,_=mpjpe(pack(gt, pose=torch.cat((gp[:,:1], qp[:,1:22], gp[:,22:]),1)), gt, gender)
            add('fk_trans',mt); add('fk_root',mr); add('fk_body',mb)
    print(f'\n== {split} sampled {len(idx)}/{len(data)}')
    for k,v in acc.items():
        print(f'{k:10} {np.mean(v):8.3f}')

run('val',120,fk=False)
```

```bash
.venv/bin/python - << 'PY'
import torch, numpy as np
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader
from unified_hoi.token_ar.codecs import load_codecs, canonicalize
from unified_hoi.token_ar.data import MotionDataset
from unified_hoi.token_ar.body import digest_file, BodyGeometry, split_human

device=torch.device('cuda:0')
codecs,_=load_codecs('runs/token_ar/behave/vq_residual_ema_512x4096/last.pt', device=device)
support='data/parametric_assets/behave/contact_support.npz'
sh=digest_file(support)
geom=BodyGeometry('behave', support).to(device).eval()
h=codecs.models['human']
ds=MotionDataset('data/processed/behave_parametric.jsonl','val','behave',sh,120,include_geometry=False)
batch=next(iter(DataLoader(ds, batch_sampler=[[0]])))
gender=batch['gender'].to(device)
T=int(batch['valid_frames'].sum())
gt=batch['human'][0,:T].to(device)
q=h._decode(h.codebook(h._nearest(h._latent(gt))), T)
q,_=canonicalize(q, batch['object'][0,:T].to(device), 'behave')
b,p,t=split_human(gt,'behave')
_,qp,qt=split_human(q,'behave')
def rel(human):
    _,j=geom(human[None], gender)
    j=j[0]
    return j-j[:,:1]
base=rel(gt)
# only trans
only=torch.cat((b,p.flatten(1),qt),-1)
d=float((rel(only)-base).norm(dim=-1).mean())
print('only trans relative joint m', d, 'param trans m', float(torch.linalg.vector_norm(qt-t,dim=-1).mean()))
onlyr=torch.cat((b, torch.cat((qp[:,:1], p[:,1:]),1).flatten(1), t), -1)
print('only root relative joint m', float((rel(onlyr)-base).norm(dim=-1).mean()))
print('full relative joint m', float((rel(q)-base).norm(dim=-1).mean()))
```

旧代码把绝对世界坐标和朝向直接喂给 VQ，码本被迫记住“这段动作当时朝哪个方向、站在房间哪边”。这行不通，因为 VQ 是自编码器，输入里已经包含了这些信息，码本不该再重复记录。

损失在数百维上平均，根朝向的误差被淹没在关节误差里。训练时同一窗口被反复看到近十万次，网络记住了绝对姿态而非学习朝向传递。验证时根方向偏差约78度、水平平移约42厘米，且这些错误在查码本前就已存在。

新方法把每段动作的首帧当作基准：先算出人体根的朝向和水平平移，再把整段场景（人和物体）一起旋转平移到标准起点。竖直高度、局部关节弯曲、接触标签都保持不变。码本只负责记录这段窗口里动作怎么变，不再需要记住采集时的绝对朝向和位置。

解码后把场景按同一首帧锚点还原到原始世界坐标，评估仍在原地进行。

旧方法的根因在于：绝对朝向和房间位置对每段采集都是任意的，文本里并没有“朝北”这样的约束。512 个码本条目只能记住训练集的朝向，无法把新数据的朝向表示为局部运动的小变化。损失函数对朝向错误的惩罚远小于关节误差，优化器只求局部关节大致正确，便放任未见数据上的朝向错误。

_**Agent (grok-4.7)**_

以前的码本被要求记住「人当时朝哪边、站在房间哪一块」，而这和动作本身没关系。新的做法是先把每个小段挪到一个统一的起点，码本只记这段里面动作怎么变，解码后再搬回原来的位置。

可以把它想成记一段跳舞。真正要记的是抬手、转身、往前走了几步。以前我们连「这段采集时人面朝东北、站在房间左边两米」也写进了同一个码本。换一段没见过的采集，人可能面朝西南、站在另一边，码本里没有这个「房间坐标」，根节点朝向就会偏到大约 80°，人的位置偏出大约 40 cm。关节还大致像那么回事，人却朝错了方向、站错了地方。

具体说，每一小段 120 帧在送进网络之前，看第一帧：人面朝哪边、脚落在水平面上的哪一点。然后把人和物体一起转、一起平移，让这段的开头变成「面朝标准方向、水平位置在原点」。身高不动，胳膊和腿的弯曲不动，接触标签也不动，因为那些贴在身体表面上，不随整个场景转动而改变。人和物体必须用同一次挪动。如果只转人、不转椅子，手和椅子的相对位置就错了，接触会对不上。

解码之后，再按记住的第一帧朝向和位置搬回去。所以评估时看到的仍是原来的世界坐标，不是一个被抹掉位置的动作。

这和 T2M-GPT 的想法一样：码本负责「相对起始姿势，身体怎么动」，不负责「这段视频在世界里的绝对朝向和落点」。绝对朝向每次采集都不一样，512 个码记不住所有房间位置；而且旧损失把几百个关节通道平摊，根朝向只有 6 个数，转错 80° 对损失影响很小，对关节误差影响很大。网络就去记训练集里见过的那些朝向，没见过的验证片段就对不上。

_**Agent (grok-4.7)**_

512 是训练前定好的词典大小，不是从 BEHAVE 里数出来的。

人体、物体、接触各有一本自己的词典，每本 512 个条目。编码器把一小段动作变成一个向量，再从这 512 个条目里挑最近的一个，记下一个 0 到 511 的整数。这个整数就是一个码。训练只决定这 512 个条目各自长什么样，不决定有几个。

这个数是照着现有做法取的。T2M-GPT 的码本就是 512 个条目，Uni-HOI 写的也是 512 个条目。2026-10-29 定这套量化器时，沿用了这个大小。旧模型是 512 个条目、每个 4096 维；现在重训的是 512 个条目、每个 512 维。前面的 512 是条目个数，后面的 512 或 4096 是每个条目有多长，两回事。

import torch

```bash
    for k in keys:
        if k in stats:
            print(f"  {k} {stats[k]:.4f}")
    del model
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()
```

from unified_hoi.token_ar.codecs import load_codecs, valid_lengths

        if i &gt;= batches:
            break
        batch = move_batch(batch, &#34;cuda&#34;)
        values, valid = batch[&#34;contact&#34;], batch[&#34;valid_frames&#34;]
        for n in sorted(set(valid_lengths(valid))):
            index = [k for k, length in enumerate(valid_lengths(valid)) if length == n]
            tgt = values[index, :n]
            x = ((tgt - module.mean) / module.std).transpose(1, 2)
            if n % module.config.stride:
                x = torch.nn.functional.pad(x, (0, (-n) % module.config.stride), mode=&#34;replicate&#34;)
            z = module.encoder(x).transpose(1, 2)
            pred = module.decoder(module.codebook(module._nearest(z)).transpose(1, 2)).transpose(1, 2)[:, :n]
            logits.append(pred.reshape(-1))
            target.append(tgt.reshape(-1))
    logits, target = torch.cat(logits), torch.cat(target)
    prob = logits.sigmoid()
    wrong = (prob &gt;= 0.5) != (target &gt;= 0.5)
    confident_wrong = wrong &amp; (prob - 0.5).abs() &gt; 0.4
    pos = target &gt;= 0.5
    return dict(logit_abs=float(logits.abs().mean()), prob=float(prob.mean()),
                positive_rate=float(pos.float().mean()),
                recall=float((prob[pos] &gt;= 0.5).float().mean()) if pos.any() else 0,
                confident_wrong=float(confident_wrong.float().mean()),
                wrong=float(wrong.float().mean()))

for step, path in ((&#34;11000&#34;, &#34;/tmp/vq_canonical_step11000.pt&#34;), (&#34;64000&#34;, &#34;/tmp/vq_canonical_step64000.pt&#34;)):

    print(step, &#34;TRAIN&#34;, contact_stats(model, train, 4))
    print(step, &#34;VAL  &#34;, contact_stats(model, val, 1))
    del model
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()

```bash
import torch
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader
from unified_hoi.runtime import move_batch
from unified_hoi.token_ar.body import digest_file
from unified_hoi.token_ar.codecs import load_codecs, valid_lengths
from unified_hoi.token_ar.data import MotionDataset

support = digest_file("data/parametric_assets/behave/contact_support.npz")
kwargs = dict(manifest="data/processed/behave_parametric.jsonl", dataset="behave", support_hash=support, window=120, include_geometry=False)
train = DataLoader(MotionDataset(split="train", stride=60, **kwargs), batch_size=32, shuffle=False)
val = DataLoader(MotionDataset(split="val", **kwargs), batch_size=98, shuffle=False)

def contact_stats(model, loader, batches):
    module = model.models["contact"]
    logits, target = [], []
    for i, batch in enumerate(loader):
        if i >= batches:
            break
        batch = move_batch(batch, "cuda")
        values, valid = batch["contact"], batch["valid_frames"]
        for n in sorted(set(valid_lengths(valid))):
            index = [k for k, length in enumerate(valid_lengths(valid)) if length == n]
            tgt = values[index, :n]
            x = ((tgt - module.mean) / module.std).transpose(1, 2)
            if n % module.config.stride:
                x = torch.nn.functional.pad(x, (0, (-n) % module.config.stride), mode="replicate")
            z = module.encoder(x).transpose(1, 2)
            pred = module.decoder(module.codebook(module._nearest(z)).transpose(1, 2)).transpose(1, 2)[:, :n]
            logits.append(pred.reshape(-1))
            target.append(tgt.reshape(-1))
    logits, target = torch.cat(logits), torch.cat(target)
    prob = logits.sigmoid()
    wrong = (prob >= 0.5) != (target >= 0.5)
    confident_wrong = wrong & (prob - 0.5).abs() > 0.4
    pos = target >= 0.5
    return dict(logit_abs=float(logits.abs().mean()), prob=float(prob.mean()),
                positive_rate=float(pos.float().mean()),
                recall=float((prob[pos] >= 0.5).float().mean()) if pos.any() else 0,
                confident_wrong=float(confident_wrong.float().mean()),
                wrong=float(wrong.float().mean()))

for step, path in (("11000", "/tmp/vq_canonical_step11000.pt"), ("64000", "/tmp/vq_canonical_step64000.pt")):
    model, _ = load_codecs(path, device="cuda")
    print(step, "TRAIN", contact_stats(model, train, 4))
    print(step, "VAL  ", contact_stats(model, val, 1))
    del model
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()
```

```bash
                x = torch.nn.functional.pad(x, (0, (-n) % module.config.stride), mode="replicate")
            z = module.encoder(x).transpose(1, 2)
            pred = module.decoder(module.codebook(module._nearest(z)).transpose(1, 2)).transpose(1, 2)[:, :n]
            logits.append(pred.reshape(-1))
            target.append(tgt.reshape(-1))
    logits, target = torch.cat(logits), torch.cat(target)
    prob = logits.sigmoid()
    wrong = (prob >= 0.5) != (target >= 0.5)
    confident = (prob - 0.5).abs() > 0.4
    pos = target >= 0.5
    return dict(logit_abs=float(logits.abs().mean()),
                positive_rate=float(pos.float().mean()),
                recall=float((prob[pos] >= 0.5).float().mean()) if int(pos.sum()) else 0,
                wrong=float(wrong.float().mean()),
                confident_wrong=float((wrong & confident).float().mean()))

for step, path in (("11000", "/tmp/vq_canonical_step11000.pt"), ("64000", "/tmp/vq_canonical_step64000.pt")):
    model, _ = load_codecs(path, device="cuda")
    print(step, "TRAIN", contact_stats(model, train, 4))
    print(step, "VAL  ", contact_stats(model, val, 1))
    del model
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()
PY
```
